## the user problem

Describe the situation a real user is in. What are they trying to do?
What's not working today?

## what you'd want to see

Your proposed solution or direction.

## scope check

Before opening, check `docs/SPEC.md` and the "out of scope" list in
`CONTRIBUTING.md`. Some categories of feature are intentionally absent.
If this request touches one of those, explain why this case is different.
